subject: Stair Climbing Cuts Cardiovascular Death Risk by 39%: The Biophysics of Vertical Exertion
script: From Agewell Brief: Stair Climbing Cuts Cardiovascular Death Risk by 39%: The Biophysics of Vertical Exertion. A meta-analysis of 480,000 people shows that choosing stairs over lifts is a potent longevity lever. Here’s the mitochondrial and vascular mechanics behind the numbers. Cardiovascular disease remains the world’s leading killer, with cases nearly doubling between 1990 and 2019. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
